content.text: can one of y'all confirm the size limit for bags in APTrust? And, if there are any other gotchas that are not reflected in the Google doc linked in the description?
Size limit confirmed. Here's text from the APTrust bagit spec:

Initially bags sent to APTrust should be limited to 250 GB for the final tarred bag. Space available for temporary file processing puts a practical limit on total bag sizes in APTurst. We expect this limit to grow over time but the initial performance data will help determine the final limits for the service.
Oh, one additional requirement I just noticed in APTrust's documentation:
Bag untars to a directory whose name matches the name of the tar file, minus the .tar extension.
beat me to it, but for good measure I'll add the link to the full bagit profile:
I've created a draft profile in the initial Bag profile implementation:
is merged, but I'd like to use this ticket to confirm the APTrust profile is correct.
Also we are not doing multiple bags yet, so we are not conforming to the bag size limit. That should be done before we close this.

, so far I think we've said that we can punt on Bag file naming, serialization/packaging, and size limits: the user can provide the names, archive and split using external tools, so that can wait for a later stage (if ever).

Might need to explore bag sequences to adhere to the 250GB limit

comments.body: Joshua Allan Westgard, Ben Goldman, kestlund, Benjamin Armintor can one of y'all confirm the size limit for bags in APTrust? And, if there are any other gotchas that are not reflected in the Google doc linked in the description?

Size limit confirmed. Here's text from the APTrust bagit spec:

Initially bags sent to APTrust should be limited to 250 GB for the final tarred bag. Space available for temporary file processing puts a practical limit on total bag sizes in APTurst. We expect this limit to grow over time but the initial performance data will help determine the final limits for the service.

Oh, one additional requirement I just noticed in APTrust's documentation:

Bag untars to a directory whose name matches the name of the tar file, minus the .tar extension.

Looks like Ben Goldman beat me to it, but for good measure I'll add the link to the full bagit profile:

https://sites.google.com/a/aptrust.org/aptrust-wiki/technical-documentation/processing-ingest/aptrust-bagit-profile
I've created a draft profile in the initial Bag profile implementation: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/63
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/pull/63 is merged, but I'd like to use this ticket to confirm the APTrust profile is correct.
Also we are not doing multiple bags yet, so we are not conforming to the bag size limit. That should be done before we close this.

Jared Whiklo, so far I think we've said that we can punt on Bag file naming, serialization/packaging, and size limits: the user can provide the names, archive and split using external tools, so that can wait for a later stage (if ever).
